result.topic_en: Notes on Jacobi theta functions: series definitions, their relation to Jacobi's elliptic functions sn, cn, dn, quasi-periodicity under shifts by $\pi i$ and $\log q$, and the four-variable theta product identities.
result.transcription:
$\vartheta(v,q) = \sum (-1)^n q^{n^2} e^{2nv}$
$\vartheta_1(v,q) = \sum (-1)^n q^{\frac{(2n+1)^2}{4}} e^{(2n+1)v}$
$\vartheta_2(v,q) = \sum q^{\frac{(2n+1)^2}{4}} e^{(2n+1)v}$
$\vartheta_3(v,q) = \sum q^{n^2} e^{2nv}$

$\vartheta(v,q) = \Theta(\frac{2vK}{\pi i}, k)$
$\vartheta_1(v,q) = i\,\Theta_1(\frac{2vK}{\pi i}, k)$
$\vartheta_2(v,q) = \Theta_2(\frac{2vK}{\pi i}, k)$ [-$=\vartheta_1(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i, q)$-]
$\vartheta_3(v,q) = \Theta_3(\frac{2vK}{\pi i}, k)$

$\sqrt{k}\,\sin am(u,k) = \frac{\Theta_1(u,k)}{\Theta(u,k)}$
$\sqrt{\frac{k}{k'}}\cos am(u,k) = \frac{\Theta_2(u,k)}{\Theta(u,k)}$
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{k'}}\Delta am(u,k) = \frac{\Theta_3(u,k)}{\Theta(u,k)}$

[-$\vartheta(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q) = \vartheta_3(v,q)$-]
[-$\vartheta_1(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q)$-]
$e^{\frac{vv}{\log q}}\vartheta(v,q) = \sum (-1)^n e^{\frac{(\log q\, n + v)^2}{\log q}}$
$e^{\frac{vv}{\log q}}\vartheta_3(v,q) = \sum e^{\frac{(\log q\, n+v)^2}{\log q}}$
$e^{\frac{vv}{\log q}}\vartheta(v,q) = (-1)^n e^{\frac{(v+n\log q)^2}{\log q}}\vartheta(v+n\log q, q)$
$\vartheta_1 \quad = (-1)^n \quad \vartheta_1$
$\vartheta_2 \quad = \quad \vartheta_2$
$\vartheta_3 \quad = \quad \vartheta_3$

$\vartheta(v+m\pi i,q) = \vartheta(v,q)$
$\vartheta_1(v+m\pi i,q) = (-1)^m\vartheta_1(v,q)$
$\vartheta_2(v+m\pi i,q) = (-1)^m\vartheta_2(v,q)$
$\vartheta_3(v+m\pi i,q) = \vartheta_3(v,q)$

$\vartheta(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q) = \vartheta_3(v,q)$
$\vartheta_1(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q) = i\,\vartheta_2(v,q)$
$\vartheta_2(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q) = i\,\vartheta_1(v,q)$
$\vartheta_3(v+\frac{\pi}{2}i,q) = \vartheta(v,q)$

$e^{\frac{(v+\frac{2m+1}{2}\log q)^2}{\log q}}\vartheta(v+\frac{2m+1}{2}\log q, q) = e^{\frac{vv}{\log q}}(-1)^m\vartheta_1$
$\vartheta_1 \quad = (-1)^{m+1}\vartheta$
$\vartheta_2 \quad = \vartheta_3$
$\vartheta_3 \quad = \vartheta_2$

$2v_1 = v+v'+v''+v'''$
$2v_1' = v+v'-v''-v'''$
$2v_1'' = v-v'+v''-v'''$
$2v_1''' = v-v'-v''+v'''$
$v_1^2+v_1'^2+v_1''^2+v_1'''^2 = v^2+v'^2+v''^2+v'''^2$

$\vartheta_3(v,q)\vartheta_3(v',q)\vartheta_3(v'',q)\vartheta_3(v''',q)+\vartheta_2(v,q)\vartheta_2(v',q)\vartheta_2(v'',q)\vartheta_2(v''',q)$
$=\vartheta_3(v_1,q)\vartheta_3(v_1',q)\vartheta_3(v_1'',q)\vartheta_3(v_1''',q)+\vartheta_2(v_1,q)\vartheta_2(v_1',q)\vartheta_2(v_1'',q)\vartheta_2(v_1''',q)$

$\Pi\vartheta_3 - \Pi\vartheta_2 = \Pi_1\vartheta + \Pi_1\vartheta_1$
$\Pi\vartheta + \Pi\vartheta_1 = \Pi_1\vartheta_3 - \Pi_1\vartheta_2$
$\Pi\vartheta - \Pi\vartheta_1 = \Pi_1\vartheta - \Pi_1\vartheta_1$

$\vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 - \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2 = \vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 - \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2$
$\vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 + \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2 = \vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta - \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1$
$\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta - \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1 = \vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 + \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2$
$\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta + \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1 = \vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta + \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1$

$2\Pi_1\vartheta_3 = \Pi\vartheta_3 + \Pi\vartheta_2 + \Pi\vartheta + \Pi\vartheta_1$
$2\Pi_1\vartheta_2 = \Pi\vartheta_3 + \Pi\vartheta_2 - \Pi\vartheta - \Pi\vartheta_1$
$2\Pi_1\vartheta = \Pi\vartheta_3 - \Pi\vartheta_2 + \Pi\vartheta - \Pi\vartheta_1$

$2\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta = \vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta + \vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 + \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1 + \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2$
$2\vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3 =$
$\vartheta_3\vartheta_3$

(1) $\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta_3,\ \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_2,\ \vartheta\vartheta\vartheta\vartheta,\ \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_1$
(2) $\vartheta_3\vartheta_3\vartheta\vartheta,\ \vartheta_2\vartheta_2\vartheta_1\vartheta_1,\ \vartheta\vartheta\vartheta_3\vartheta_3,\ \vartheta_1\vartheta_1\vartheta_2\vartheta_2$

B. Riemann's [?] Nachlass [?]
